{{Quote|Either way, we're stuck with the fact that it's definitely an alien encampment."<br />"And therefore stuck with the UAE Orders.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Mosh Barris/Legends|Mosh Barris]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]]|<ref name="Mist Encounter">{{JournalCite|7|Mist Encounter}}</ref>}}
The '''Unknown Alien Encounters Orders''' were a set of standing orders within the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] dating from its so-called glory days which dictated responses upon encountering possible [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life. Abbreviated as the '''UAE Orders''', they were still in force at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] despite the fact that most officers regarded them as out-of-date bureaucratic burdens. Due to significant support within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], they were difficult to revoke. They remained current into the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; however, by that time, word was circulating around the fleet that [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was promising that the UAE Orders would be stricken from the books soon.
